answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 33 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The quartz register is checked at draw time, vertex lists the eligible set, and pearl seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 33 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. Each copy needs 2 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
